verses.text: The LORD said to Moses,
"Tell the people of Israel to bring me an offering. Receive the offering for me from everyone whose heart makes them want to give.
These are the offerings you are to receive from them: gold, silver, and bronze;
blue, purple, and red yarn; fine linen; goat hair;
ram skins dyed red; fine leather; acacia wood;
olive oil for the lamps; spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet-smelling incense;
and onyx stones and other jewels to be set in the ephod and the chest piece of the high priest.
Then have them make a holy place for me, and I will live among them.
Make this holy tent and all its furniture exactly like the pattern I will show you.
Have them make a box, the ark, out of acacia wood. It is to be about one metre and ten centimetres long, and about seventy centimetres wide and seventy centimetres high.
Cover it with pure gold, inside and out, and put a gold border around it.
Make four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, two rings on one side and two rings on the other.
Then make poles of acacia wood and cover them with gold.
Put the poles through the rings on the sides of the ark, to carry it.
The poles must stay in the rings of the ark. They must not be taken out.
Then put inside the ark the tablets of the covenant that I will give you.
Make a cover for the ark out of pure gold. This is the place of mercy. It is to be about one metre and ten centimetres long and seventy centimetres wide.
Make two cherubim out of hammered gold for the two ends of the cover.
Make one cherub on one end and the other cherub on the other end. Make the cherubim and the cover all one piece.
The cherubim are to have their wings spread upwards, covering the cover with their wings. They are to face each other, looking down towards the cover.
Put the cover on top of the ark, and put inside the ark the tablets of the covenant that I will give you.
There, above the cover between the two cherubim on the ark of the covenant, I will meet with you. From there I will give you all my commands for the people of Israel.
Make a table out of acacia wood. It is to be about ninety centimetres long, forty-five centimetres wide, and seventy centimetres high.
Cover it with pure gold and put a gold border around it.
Make a rim around it about as wide as a hand, and put a gold border on the rim.
Make four gold rings for the table, and fasten them to the four corners, where the four legs are.
The rings are to be close to the rim, to hold the poles used to carry the table.
Make the poles out of acacia wood and cover them with gold. The table is to be carried with them.
Make its plates, dishes, jars, and bowls out of pure gold. They are to be used for pouring out drink offerings.
Always keep the special bread on the table in front of me.
Make a lampstand out of pure gold. Hammer out its base and its stem. Its flower-shaped cups, buds, and blossoms are to be all one piece with it.
Six branches are to come out from the sides of the lampstand, three on one side and three on the other.
Each of the six branches is to have three cups shaped like almond flowers, with buds and blossoms.
And on the lampstand itself there are to be four cups shaped like almond flowers, with buds and blossoms.
One bud is to be under the first pair of branches, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair. All six branches come out from the lampstand.
The buds and the branches are all to be one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
Then make its seven lamps and set them up on it, so that they light the space in front of it.
Its wick cutters and trays are to be made of pure gold.
Use about thirty-four kilograms of pure gold to make the lampstand and all these tools.
Be sure to make them exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain."
